about_title: Open, enclosed and sheet + tube fiber lasers at a price a small shop can justify
about_text: A fiber laser cutting machine cuts sheet and plate from a DXF file with a focused beam — mild steel to 1″ with 6 kW and to 2″ and beyond with 20 to 30 kW — at speeds no plasma or punch can match, with a clean edge and no tooling. The ULF is the open single-table laser: the G build from 1.5 to 6 kW, the heavier E build to 12 kW and 1.7 G, and large-format plate tables to 85 × 10.5 ft with up to 60 kW. The ULE puts the cutting area in a full enclosure and swaps two tables in 15 seconds, from 10 × 5 to 41 × 8.5 ft and 3 to 40 kW. The ULG runs its gantry on floor rails over a plate table 42.7 or 85.3 ft long and up to 14.8 ft wide, with 12 to 60 kW. The ULFT and ULET add a pneumatic chuck for tube to Ø13.8″ and 39 ft, so one machine cuts sheet and tube.

NovoTech Machine Tools sells, installs and supports sheet-metal and fabrication machinery across Canada from Mississauga, ON, Canada. The value line is our own brand: machines built in China to our specification with established components — Raycus, MAX or IPG sources, Raytools, BOCI or Precitec heads, Cypcut controls, Hiwin guides, YYC racks and Schneider electrics — inspected before they ship, with a CSA-approved panel, a 1-year warranty, operator training and parts and service from Mississauga, ON, Canada.
